overview.title: Website
overview.subtitle: Manage your Academy's public website from one place.

sitemapPreview.title: Sitemap preview
sitemapPreview.help: The pages a future public website would list in its sitemap, based on what's currently published, visible and indexable. Nothing here is served yet.
sitemapPreview.empty: Nothing would appear in the sitemap yet — publish your website and make sure pages are visible and indexable.

content.title: Content
content.subtitle: Reusable FAQ and testimonial content, plus your blog and announcements.
content.archiveConfirmDescription: It will no longer appear on your website, even where it's referenced from a page. This does not delete it and can be reversed later.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Your Academy's knowledge blog posts, managed on their own dedicated page.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Announcements published to your students and courses.

subdomain.title: Atlas subdomain
subdomain.notConfigured: Atlas's platform domain isn't configured yet, so a subdomain address isn't available for your website. This will appear automatically once it is.

custom.title: Custom domain
custom.empty: You haven't connected a custom domain yet.
custom.addError: Failed to start connecting this domain
custom.removeConfirmDescription: Your website will fall back to its Atlas subdomain. This can be reconnected later.

platformDomain.title: Platform Domain
platformDomain.subtitle: Configure the base domain Academy subdomains are derived from.
platformDomain.baseDomainHelp: Once set, an Academy with the slug "harvard" becomes reachable at "harvard.{{baseDomain}}" — this field doesn't perform any real DNS setup itself.
platformDomain.error: Failed to save the platform domain
platformDomain.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to the platform domain.
platformDomain.infrastructureHelp: Whether Atlas's backend currently has real Cloudflare credentials configured. This is a read-only status — credentials are never entered here or exposed to this dashboard.

notFound.title: Website not found
notFound.description: We couldn't find a website at this address.

unavailable.title: Temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: This website can't be reached right now. Please try again shortly.

unpublished.title: Coming soon
unpublished.description: This website hasn't been published yet.

pageNotFound.title: Page not found
pageNotFound.description: This page doesn't exist or is no longer available.

settings.title: Website
settings.subtitle: Configure your Academy's public website — theme, branding, SEO and navigation.

modernEducation.name: Modern Education
modernEducation.description: Friendly and approachable, with a split hero and elevated cards.

premiumAcademy.name: Premium Academy
premiumAcademy.description: Upscale and elegant, with a centered hero and generous whitespace.

corporateLearning.name: Corporate Learning
corporateLearning.description: Structured and professional, built for enterprise training providers.

minimalEditorial.name: Minimal Editorial
minimalEditorial.description: Restrained and typographic, letting your content speak for itself.

boldCreative.name: Bold Creative
boldCreative.description: Energetic and expressive, for academies that want to stand out.

brand.contrastWarning: This color may be hard to read as text on a light background.
brand.darkLogoHelp: Used wherever the theme places your logo on a dark surface.
brand.primaryLogoNote: Your primary logo and favicon are managed on your Academy's Branding page.

seo.canonicalBaseUrlHelp: A real, verified domain is connected later in your website's lifecycle — this is only used to compose canonical links once it is.
seo.robotsIndexable: Allow search engines to index this website
seo.sitemapEnabled: Include this website in the sitemap
seo.indexable: Allow search engines to index this page
seo.structuredDataPreviewHelp: A preview of the structured data (JSON-LD) a future public website would publish for search engines and social platforms — nothing here is published yet.
seo.resolvedFallbackHint: If you leave the fields below blank, this page currently falls back to: "{{title}}" / "{{description}}".

pages.title: Pages
pages.subtitle: Your website's core and custom pages.
pages.deleteConfirmDescription: "{{title}}" and its content will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

editor.title: Page Editor
editor.subtitle: Compose this page from sections, then save your changes.
editor.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to this page.
editor.deleteConfirmDescription: This section and its content will be removed from the page. This cannot be undone.
editor.invalidConfig: Some values need to be corrected before this can be saved.
editor.libraryEntriesHelpFaq: Published FAQ entries you select here appear on this section, alongside any items added directly below.
editor.libraryEntriesHelpTestimonials: Published testimonials you select here appear on this section, alongside any items added directly below.

preview.subtitle: See your draft website exactly as the renderer will produce it.
